title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1972-09-10
source: SBD > [MR > C > DAT(s) ??] > CDR(s) > EAC > SHN > SHNTOOL (fix sector boundaries by sets) > mkwact (seekable)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy show highlighted by an extended Bird Song and a vivid Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers clear, well‑balanced soundboard audio that lets the band's tight playing shine. Fans rave about the soaring Bird Song, the powerful Dark Star with its Crosby‑tinged colors, and a punchy second set featuring He's Gone, Truckin' and Ramble on Rose. Overall energy is high and the performance feels like a true time‑machine ride.

ai_rating.rationale: A single detailed 5‑star review praises both musical performance and sound quality, indicating an outstanding show with excellent soundboard recording; limited sample size lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No technical complaints; reviewers describe the audio as clear and well‑balanced, allowing instrument detail to be heard.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong second set with smooth transitions (time‑machine feel) and a well‑paced overall flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work is praised, especially on 'Sugaree' and the extended Bird Song.
